verdict.rationale: Grafana has mechanisms that can act on many resources at once: file-based provisioning and observability-as-code let you define dashboards and data sources in version-controlled files deployed via CI/CD. A terminal CLI handles administrative tasks across multiple environments, and an OpenAPI spec and MCP server allow scripted or agent-driven access. None of the evidence describes a dedicated bulk-operation feature, so bulk changes are implied through as-code and scripting rather than shown directly. Missing for 10: explicit bulk edit/delete/move actions on dashboards, alerts or other items; documented bulk API endpoints; hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk workflows.
